caption:
A wild sea otter floating on its back in Morro Bay, California, paws over its face.

Sea otters have the densest fur of any mammal, about 100,000 hairs in every square centimetre. They have no insulating fat, so they eat, rest and groom at the surface to keep that coat working.

Source: Animal Diversity Web, Enhydra lutris.
